text: Why Skyscanner? Learn more about Skyscanner and how we work Skyscanner home Help Why you should always start trip planning on Skyscanner Before you book, compare hundreds of options on Skyscanner in one simple search We want to bring the world to you. From choosing a destination, to finding the best price, we want you to have all the options at your fingertips. That's why we're focused on making travel better for everyone. To make the entire planning and booking experience easy, simple and enjoyable from start to finish. To make sure you get the most for your money, and from your trip. And to make our industry more transparent and deserving of your trust. This spirit shines through everything we do. We've always got your back and we're proud to be the most trusted travel search site in the world (our travellers rate us more highly than the likes of Kayak, Momondo and Expedia*). Here are just some of the ways we're putting you first: Get the best price We price check with 1,200 travel companies so you don't have to. Sign up for Price Alerts and we'll tell you as soon as fares change on a flight you like. Then you can decide whether to book - or not. Fare's fair We show you results from a huge number of airlines and online travel agents. Travellers are at the heart of what we do, so we'll remove providers from Skyscanner if we believe they aren't doing the right thing by you. Just go (even on the go) Loved by you for its ease of use and value for money, our app helps you plan your entire trip. Whether you're looking for flights, hotels or car hire (maybe even all three) you can quickly see your options, pick up your plans where you left off and save all your trip details in one place. See who's tried and trusted Travellers rate their booking experience with the airlines and online travel agents on our site, helping you choose the best providers. We also share that feedback with them so they can keep getting better and give you the service you deserve. No pressure We never use your data to bump up prices or artificially create demand. We believe the price you see should be the price you pay and won't pressure you to book. No nasty surprises or hidden fees. Explore Everywhere. From anywhere. Where to go? When? The possibilities are endless. Our 'Everywhere' search inspires millions of travellers by finding all the best fares from their chosen airport. Find a place to stay Save money on your room, as well your flights. We work with the biggest names in travel and have special deals with the world's leading hotels to share with you. Hit the road happy We bring the same simplicity to car hire as we do to booking flights. With filters for fuel policy and pickup location, you can choose the option that works best for you. Expert tips and tricks We've been finding the best flights since 2003 and share that knowledge with you. With Mash-ups, you can mix and match flights to get the best deal, like flying out with one airline and back with another. Travel with a conscience Our role is to share unbiased information to help travellers make an informed choice. As part of this commitment, we believe in sharing information on the environmental impact of flights. When you search, you'll be able to see which flights emit less CO2e on average for your chosen route. Your data, your choice We never use your data to hide information or mislead you into booking something you don't want. And your personal information is just that - yours. Want to know more? Read our cookie and privacy policies. Here for you Travel doesn't always go to plan but we do our best to put things right. Our helpful support teams are on hand seven days a week and offer you service in 30 languages.
